Police forced him to police station. Injuries: both police suffered minor injuries (轻微伤). So crimes: assault (故意伤害) causing minor injury to police officers. Also assault to a private person (李某2) causing? Not specified injuries to her, but he punched/kicked. Could be故意伤害罪. Also obstruction of official duties (妨害公务) for assaulting police while performing duty. The correction rules: When defendant bites or assaults police while resisting law enforcement, charge only 妨害公务 unless there is... The rule says: "When the factual scenario involves a defendant biting or otherwise assaulting a police officer while resisting law‑enforcement duties, charge only 妨害公务 (obstruction of official duties) unless there is". The rule seems incomplete but suggests that assault on police is charged as 妨害公务, not as故意伤害. So we should charge 妨害公务 for assaulting police. For assault on private person, we have故意伤害.
